key_errors:
CMake Error at /__w/openvino/openvino/openvino.genai/CMakeLists.txt:60 (find_package):
  Could not find a configuration file for package "OpenVINO" that is
  compatible with requested version "2026.5.0".

  The following configuration files were considered but not accepted:

    /__w/openvino/openvino/build/OpenVINOConfig.cmake, version: 2026.4.0

-- Configuring incomplete, errors occurred!
##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.
root_cause: The openvino.genai submodule (checked out alongside the OpenVINO source tree) declares find_package(OpenVINO 2026.5.0 REQUIRED) in its CMakeLists.txt:60, but the OpenVINO build in this merge-queue run produces an OpenVINOConfig.cmake that reports version 2026.4.0. This version mismatch causes CMake configuration to abort. The PR itself (fixing a C API test) does not touch CMake version files or the genai submodule, so the failure is a pre-existing incompatibility between the master branch CMake version declaration and the pinned openvino.genai submodule version.
reproduction_steps: Clone openvinotoolkit/openvino, check out the merge-queue branch, configure with the same Android CMake flags. The genai submodule's CMakeLists.txt will fail to find the locally-built OpenVINO package.
recommended_actions: Identify which commit bumped openvino.genai's required OpenVINO version to 2026.5.0 and whether the OpenVINO CMake version was supposed to be bumped at the same time.
Bump the OpenVINO project version in cmake/developer_package/version.cmake (or equivalent) from 2026.4.0 to 2026.5.0 if a version bump is due.
Alternatively, if openvino.genai was updated prematurely, revert or pin it to a version compatible with 2026.4.0.
Check whether the same failure occurs on other workflows (Linux, Windows) to determine scope.
prevention_strategies: Enforce that openvino.genai submodule version updates are always paired with a matching OpenVINO version bump in the same PR (or landed atomically). Add a CI check that validates the OpenVINO version declared in the build matches the minimum required by all submodules.
historical_context: No prior pattern found with this exact signature. This appears to be the first occurrence.
